#### fresh generation
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  RUBY-BUNDLER-CACHE: true
  RUBY-VERSION: <ruby-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  markdownlint:
    name: Markdown Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Markdownlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/markdownlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  rubocop:
    name: Ruby Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Rubocop
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/rubocop@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Semgrep
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/semgrep@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  shellcheck:
    name: Shell Scripts Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: ShellCheck
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/shellcheck@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  yamllint:
    name: YAML Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Yamllint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/yamllint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  licenses:
    name: Licenses Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Licenses
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/soup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        parameters: "--no_prompt"
  shell_script_unit_tests:
    name: Shell Script Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Bats Install
      shell: bash
      run: |-
        if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
          brew install bats-core
        else
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bats
        fi
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Bats
      shell: bash
      run: bats tests/
  ruby_unit_tests:
    name: Ruby Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        ruby-version: "${{env.RUBY-VERSION}}"
        ruby-bundler-cache: "${{env.RUBY-BUNDLER-CACHE}}"
    - name: Bundler
      shell: bash
      run: bundle install
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: RSpec
      shell: bash
      run: bundle exec rspec --format documentation
  aws:
    name: AWS
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - markdownlint
    - rubocop
    - semgrep
    - shellcheck
    - yamllint
    - licenses
    - shell_script_unit_tests
    - ruby_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1') && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.markdownlint.result != 'failure' && needs.rubocop.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.shellcheck.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.licenses.result != 'failure' && needs.shell_script_unit_tests.result != 'failure' && needs.ruby_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: AWS Commands
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/aws@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        shell-commands: echo "Add your commands here!"
  slack:
    name: Publish Statuses
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - markdownlint
    - rubocop
    - semgrep
    - shellcheck
    - yamllint
    - licenses
    - shell_script_unit_tests
    - ruby_unit_tests
    - aws
    if: always()
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Publish Statuses
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/slack@v3
      with:
        webhook-url: "${{secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}}"
        jobs: "${{toJSON(needs)}}"

#### regeneration over a customized build.yml
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CUSTOM_WORKFLOW_ENV: kept
  RUBY-BUNDLER-CACHE: true
  RUBY-VERSION: <ruby-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  actionlint:
    name: Github Actions Linter

      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:

    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Actionlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/actionlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  markdownlint:
    name: Markdown Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Markdownlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/markdownlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  rubocop:
    name: Ruby Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner

#### idempotent regeneration

---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened

    steps:
    - name: Markdownlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/markdownlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  rubocop:
    name: Ruby Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:

  shell_script_unit_tests:
    name: Shell Script Unit Tests
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Bats Install
      shell: bash
      run: |-
        if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
          brew install bats-core
        else
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bats
        fi --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Bats
      shell: bash
      run: bats tests/ --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  ruby_unit_tests:
    name: Ruby Unit Tests
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        ruby-version: "${{env.RUBY-VERSION}}"
        ruby-bundler-cache: "${{env.RUBY-BUNDLER-CACHE}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Bundler
      shell: bash
      run: bundle install --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: RSpec
      shell: bash
      run: bundle exec rspec --format documentation --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  aws:
    name: AWS
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - actionlint
    - markdownlint
    - rubocop
    - semgrep
    - shellcheck
    - yamllint
    - licenses
    - shell_script_unit_tests
    - ruby_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1' || needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1') && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.actionlint.result != 'failure' && needs.markdownlint.result != 'failure' && needs.rubocop.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.shellcheck.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.licenses.result != 'failure' && needs.shell_script_unit_tests.result != 'failure' && needs.ruby_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: AWS Commands
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/aws@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        shell-commands: echo "Add your commands here!"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  slack:
    name: Publish Statuses
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - actionlint
    - markdownlint
    - rubocop
    - semgrep
    - shellcheck
    - yamllint
    - licenses
    - shell_script_unit_tests
    - ruby_unit_tests
    - aws
    if: always()
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Publish Statuses
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/slack@v3
      with:
        webhook-url: "${{secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}}"
        jobs: "${{toJSON(needs)}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
